payload.subject: Owner assigns GitHub push and merge to main to Codex
payload.body_markdown: Owner instruction: "You will also handle the push and merge to main." Codex owns the GitHub push and merge to main. Please deliver local candidates for my review and debugging; leave pushes and merges to me. The local assignment agreement before pulling/fetching/importing code remains in force. Review approval tied to the exact candidate and required checks remain prerequisites. Updated docs/plans/CODING-COORDINATION-2026-09-09.md. This message records ownership, not approval of an existing candidate.
